# Oddmash Mobile

`@oddmash/mobile-interactions` is an experimental React package for Bottom Sheet, Adaptive Dialog, Swipe Action and Pull to Refresh.

- [Alpha usage and limitations](https://github.com/Oddmash/oddmash-mobile/blob/main/docs/alpha.md)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Oddmash/oddmash-mobile/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Quality and release](https://github.com/Oddmash/oddmash-mobile/blob/main/docs/quality-and-release.md)
- [Alpha verification](https://github.com/Oddmash/oddmash-mobile/blob/main/docs/alpha-verification.md)
